What I’m looking for

  • n8n workflow development
  • WhatsApp Business/API integrations
  • AI/LLM integrations
  • APIs and webhooks
  • Google Sheets, CRMs, calendars and other business tools
  • Lead qualification, follow-ups and booking workflows
  • Human handoff/fallback logic
  • Error handling, testing and troubleshooting
  • Deployment, monitoring and maintenance
  • Basic technical documentation

Strong WhatsApp automation experience is especially valuable.

Example projects

  • WhatsApp AI lead qualification
  • FAQ and customer-support bots
  • Lead capture and CRM integration
  • Appointment booking and rescheduling
  • Automated follow-ups
  • Human-agent handoff
  • Notifications and internal alerts
  • AI-powered business workflows

Working arrangement

This is project-based, not salaried:

Client acquired → scope agreed → builder assigned → paid build/testing → deployment → maintenance if required

I am not asking anyone to work for free. Since the agency is starting from zero, I cannot guarantee monthly income or workload. However, I’m interested in building a long-term working relationship as the client pipeline grows.

Location

India is preferred for timezone and communication, but international candidates are welcome if they can provide reasonable overlap.

How to apply

Reply with “n8n builder” and DM me on Discord: “jyotirmoydas_22”

Please include:

  1. Name and location/timezone
  2. Years of n8n experience
  3. 2–3 real workflows you personally built
  4. WhatsApp/API and AI/LLM experience
  5. Production deployment and monitoring experience
  6. Preferred project-based pricing
  7. Weekly availability
  8. Portfolio, GitHub, templates, screenshots or demos, if available

Please do not send passwords, API keys, credentials, or confidential client information.

I’m looking for technically capable, reliable people who communicate clearly and take responsibility for workflows after deployment—not just build them and disappear.

If interested, reply with “n8n builder” and DM me on Discord with the requested details.

Real workflows I built personally

  1. WhatsApp lead capture → AI FAQ → human handoff. I built this for your first post before replying, so it is the closest thing to a direct sample of your client work. 11 nodes, imports into a stock n8n, with its test scripts: n8n demo: WhatsApp lead capture + AI FAQ + human handoff (built for community.n8n.io post 316359) · GitHub
    The routing fails safe rather than trusting the model: a message escalates to a person when the model flags it, when the answer came back empty, or when confidence is under 0.6. Delivery receipts are dropped in the normaliser so the bot can never answer its own read receipt.

  2. Telegram content pipeline — photos in, a single LLM call writes the caption, hashtags and site copy, one-tap publish to a Supabase-backed site plus an Instagram carousel. Model 429/503 handled with cooldowns instead of retries that stampede the rate limit.

  3. Trading automation — freqtrade running in production, with alerting and scheduled reporting over Telegram: GitHub - mohsenjfar/freqtrade: Free, open source crypto trading bot · GitHub

WhatsApp / API / AI-LLM experience
WhatsApp Cloud API: not yet in production. The workflow above is my own build of your exact use case — I’d rather you judge that than take my word for it. Technically it is a signed webhook plus a REST send endpoint, and the parts that actually cause trouble (24-hour message windows, template approval, per-conversation billing) are the ones I wrote up in the gist README.
API / webhooks: daily work. Inbound webhooks answered through a response node so the caller never times out; outbound APIs with auth, pagination and backoff.
AI / LLM: extensive. Gemini and OpenAI behind HTTP Request nodes, JSON-mode prompting, and defensive parsing for when a model returns prose instead of JSON — that case is one of the tests in the gist.

Production deployment and monitoring
Containers with restart policies, structured logs, and retry with backoff. I hold dedupe state so a re-run can never double-post or double-message. I currently run a lead-agent that polls several job boards on its own and alerts me — so the monitoring is something I use, not just something I claim.

Preferred project-based pricing
$15/hour, or fixed price per workflow when the scope is clear:

  • single-purpose workflow (like the demo above): $200
  • full WhatsApp assistant — intent routing, CRM/Sheets, booking, handoff: $450–700
  • a paid test project: welcome, at the same hourly rate

Weekly availability
Roughly 20 hours/week, adjustable toward your pipeline. When clients are acquired, I can prioritise.

Portfolio / proof

  • The WhatsApp demo and its tests: n8n demo: WhatsApp lead capture + AI FAQ + human handoff (built for community.n8n.io post 316359) · GitHub
  • freqtrade in production: GitHub - mohsenjfar/freqtrade: Free, open source crypto trading bot · GitHub
  • Screenshots of the Telegram publishing pipeline and its n8n execution logs on request.

Two things worth saying upfront

  • I take payment in USDC. Better to know now than after a test project.
  • I’ll send the same details to your Discord at jyotirmoydas22, so you have them in both places.

Your arrangement — you own clients and requirements, I own implementation and stay responsible for the workflow after deployment — is the split I want. A build that gets abandoned at handover is worse than no build, which is why the demo above ships with its tests and a README listing its known risks.
